thread.title: Amazon on track to pass Google's Alphabet as 2nd-biggest U.S. company

title: Amazon on track to pass Google's Alphabet as 2nd-biggest U.S. company
text:
Published: Mar 20, 2018 11:59 a.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor 
Amazon.com Inc.'s stock AMZN, +1.92% surged 1.4% in midday trade, to push the e-commerce giant's market-capitalization past Google-parent Alphabet Inc.'s GOOGL, -0.21% in intraday trade, which would make Amazon the second largest U.S. company. Amazon's market-cap was $758.26 billion, while Alphabet's stock fell 1.3% to knock the internet-search giant's market cap down to $755.35 billion. Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.18% is still by far the biggest U.S. company, with the stock up 0.1% to lift its market cap to $890.44 billion. Amazon's stock has soared 34% year to date, while Alphabet shares have gained 3.3% and the S&P 500 SPX, +0.17% has tacked on 1.4%. Quote References
